# Seed Poet
> Generate memorable poems using BIP39 mnemonic words

Seed Poet is a tool that creates rhyming poetry using only words from the BIP39
mnemonic wordlist (2048 words used for cryptocurrency wallet seed phrases).

## Features
- 12-word and 24-word poem generation
- Strict phonetic rhymes (couplet structure: AA BB CC...)
- Syllable-matched lines for consistent rhythm
- VERB + ADJECTIVE + NOUN sentence structure

## Purpose
Create memorable, poetic representations of BIP39-compatible word sequences.
Useful for memorization exercises or creative exploration of the BIP39 vocabulary.
